page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "splen" and "scorpij" set as "splen" and "scorpij". The Greek-style accent-like mark over "ęger" is printed as a cedilla-e and kept. The word "furfum" is read with reasonable confidence; the first "ęger" and the second "ęger" are both read from the scan. Catchword "uosis" completes the word split at the line end "ner-". The underlined Q at the start of "Quae" is a print feature and is not transcribed.
